scope.change: Use a 0.70 rather than 0.85 certainty-equivalent multiplier when comparing a profitable incoming offer with the modeled value of another counteroffer.

live_evidence.unpaired_comparator_warning: Ratings are configuration-relative and matchmaking was not randomized; the repeated direction is evidence for a narrow promotion, not a causal effect estimate.

same_observation_replay.description: Replay the promoted 0.70 trigger and legacy 0.85 trigger on archived completed-game decisions.
same_observation_replay.warning: Replay measures action scope only; opponent responses to counterfactual actions are unobserved.

synthetic_stress_test.interpretation: The small algorithmic-opponent sweep does not show a payoff gain and estimates a 0.00037 normalized-payoff cost; it is a stress test rather than a leaderboard model.

monitoring_gate: Retain only if capped private-value agreement and normalized-payoff strata do not deteriorate in the next Granola cohort.
